sections.text_helper: Section 8.10.6 "PWR wake-up status clear register (PWR_WUSCR)" in chapter 8 (Power control (PWR)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 246.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x040
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Each register bit CWUFx (x=1 to 7) is protected against unprivileged access when
PRIV=1 in PWR_PRIVCFGR.
Bits 31:7 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 6:0 CWUFx: clear wake-up pin flag for WUFx (x=7 to 1)
These bits are always read as 0.
0: No effect
1: Writing 1 clears the WUFx wake-up pin flag (bit is cleared to 0 by hardware).
